title: Görlitz Department Store
geometryBasis: The 1913 Kaufhaus zum Strauss as photographed in 2014–15, including the stone street façades, covered arcade, mansard roof and stepped east service wing.
sectionBasis: The mapped footprint and photographed openings set the horizontal scale. Heights, hidden roof details and the least visible elevations are approximate.
limitations: The photographed south façade, west arcade and east loading wing control the design. The north façade and less visible roof details use approximate symmetry and the mapped perimeter.
The terraced mansard section, four principal floor bands and narrow light court reflect the documented massing. Story-era height and small reliefs are approximate.
The original composite terrain was preserved. Foundations and arcade paving follow approximate street grade.
The three exact Qualla photos are retained in the local Qualla corpus and recorded here with their hashes.
